name: lucky-fool
unmodelled: Fortune is read from khi_van on both sides. The reference enemies carry none, so 50 is assumed, the talent's neutral point (Character Stats Formulas H), as rules/escape.py does.
The main run is the Pot alone, with no draw: roll is expected, which is the floor. The sweep line reruns the same fight on seeds 1 to 300 with true draws.
Someone Else's Problem acts after the fight, so ledger_left and years_owed print what the loser is billed. Dull Fortune is compiled into khi_van 130: base 90, comprehension 10, +40.
Slip of the Hand carried by the other side, and curse slots for Ill Omen, are not modelled: Ill Omen is a note, not a slot.
